tickerText: [TENNIS] Day two at the Mubadala DC Open brings Alex Eala vs Olympic champion Zheng Qinwen, while Kei Nishikori earned his first 2026 win and Frances Tiafoe fell to Terence Atmane • [SQUASH] World Junior Team Championships continue in Niagara-on-the-Lake as defending champions Egypt and top seeds push toward knockout play • [BADMINTON] The Philippines hosts its first BWF-sanctioned tournament as Philippine International Challenge qualifying begins at Gameville Central Park • [PICKLEBALL] Pickleball Inc. and the Pickleball World Cup unite, clearing PPA Tour pros to represent their countries starting at the 2027 edition • [TABLE TENNIS] The elite circuit shifts to WTT Champions Yokohama on August 4 after Hugo Calderano edged Alexis Lebrun 4-3 to win São José dos Campos

newsItems.title: Eala Faces Zheng in DC Open
newsItems.excerpt: Alex Eala meets Olympic champion Zheng Qinwen in Washington today as the Mubadala DC Open highlights a loaded day-two slate on the North American hard-court swing.

newsItems.title: Junior Team Titles Heat Up
newsItems.excerpt: The World Squash Junior Team Championships roll on in Niagara-on-the-Lake after Egypt's Mohamad Zakaria and India's Anahat Singh made history in the individual finals.

newsItems.title: Philippines Debuts BWF Event
newsItems.excerpt: Qualifying begins today at Gameville Central Park as the Philippines stages its first BWF-sanctioned International Challenge, led by Clarence Villaflor and Mika De Guzman.

newsItems.title: PPA Pros Cleared for World Cup
newsItems.excerpt: Pickleball Inc. and the Pickleball World Cup announced a partnership that lifts prior tour restrictions, letting eligible PPA professionals represent their countries from 2027.
